predictions.prediction_text: If volatility gets bid on a certain tenor, your option's convexity will change and the option will react differently to underlying movements, so hedges may not work as expected.
predictions.condition: vol gets bid on a certain tenor
predictions.expected_result: Option hedges that previously matched underlying exposures will diverge; delta and convexity behavior will change causing hedging P&L deviations versus prior expectations.

predictions.prediction_text: In a positive vanna regime, vol rising will be associated with delta rising (vol up/delta up), dealers will be net long delta and will sell futures, which will increase volatility further.
predictions.condition: market is in a positive vanna regime
predictions.expected_result: Dealers sell futures, futures selling pushes realized/implied volatility higher, reinforcing higher vol and higher delta dynamics.

predictions.prediction_text: If volatility is dumped when vanna crosses zero into negative territory, market makers will remain long delta and will sell, amplifying directional selling pressure.
predictions.condition: volatility dumped at the zero vanna crossing into negative vanna territory
predictions.expected_result: Market makers' net long delta leads to selling of underlying (or futures), producing additional downside pressure in the underlying asset and higher realized volatility.
